process FASTGA_FASTGA {
    tag "${meta.id}"
    label 'process_high'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container
        ? 'https://community-cr-prod.seqera.io/docker/registry/v2/blobs/sha256/68/685e31663606feff0225f6e4b79ce332c8516716a5fad8f2a411f0671f1c9126/data'
        : 'community.wave.seqera.io/library/fastga:1.5.20260729--8cb4c20b64de3563'}"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(fasta1), path(fasta2)
    val output_format

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("*.paf"), emit: paf, optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("*.psl"), emit: psl, optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("*.1aln"), emit: onealn, optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("*.1gdb"), emit: onegdb, optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("*.gix"), emit: gix, optional: true
    // WARN: Version information not provided by tool on CLI. Please update this string when bumping container versions.
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('fastga'), val("1.5.20260729"), topic: versions, emit: versions_fastga

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    def fasta_input = fasta2 ? "${fasta1} ${fasta2}" : "${fasta1}"
    def output_arg = ""
    def fmt_arg = ""
    def valid_paf_formats = ["paf", "pafx", "pafm", "pafxS", "pafxs", "pafmS", "pafms"]
    if (output_format in valid_paf_formats) {
        fmt_arg = "-${output_format}"
        output_arg = "> ${prefix}.paf"
    }
    else if (output_format == "psl") {
        fmt_arg = "-psl"
        output_arg = "> ${prefix}.psl"
    }
    else if (output_format == "1aln") {
        output_arg = "-1:${prefix}.1aln"
    }
    else {
        error("Unsupported output format: ${output_format}")
    }
    """
    FastGA \\
        -T${task.cpus} \\
        -v \\
        ${args} \\
        ${fmt_arg} \\
        ${fasta_input} \\
        ${output_arg} \\
    """

    stub:
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    """
    touch ${prefix}.paf
    touch ${prefix}.psl
    touch ${prefix}.1aln
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/fastga/fastga"
description: "Compare two genomes or a genome against itself and output a .1aln, .paf,\
  \ or .psl file of all alignments found."
keywords:
- "genome alignment"
- "paf"
- "onecode"
- "psl"
- "comparative genomics"
tools:
- fastga:
    description: "FastGA - A Fast Genome Aligner."
    homepage: "https://github.com/thegenemyers/FASTGA"
    documentation: "https://github.com/thegenemyers/FASTGA"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/thegenemyers/FASTGA"
    licence:
    - "BSD-like"
    identifier: "biotools:fastga"
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - fasta1:
      type: "file"
      description: "FASTA file of the first genome to align. If this is the only input,\
        \ this\ngenome is aligned against itself.\n"
      pattern: "*.{fa,fasta,fa.gz,fasta.gz}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_1929"
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3989"
  - fasta2:
      type: "file"
      description: "FASTA file of the second genome to align.\n"
      pattern: "*.{fa,fasta,fa.gz,fasta.gz}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_1929"
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3989"
- output_format:
    type: "string"
    description: "Output format for the alignment results. Options are:\n\n- paf (or\
      \ subtypes pafx, pafm, pafxS, pafmS, pafxs, pafms - see documentation for details)\n\
      - psl\n- 1aln\n"
output:
  paf:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*.paf':
        type: "file"
        description: "PAF file"
        pattern: "*.{paf}"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3475"
  psl:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*.psl':
        type: "file"
        description: "BLAT style PSL file"
        pattern: "*.{psl}"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3007"
  onealn:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*.1aln':
        type: "file"
        description: "1aln file"
        pattern: "*.{1aln}"
        ontologies: []
  onegdb:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*.1gdb':
        type: "file"
        description: "1gdb file"
        pattern: "*.{1gdb}"
        ontologies: []
  gix:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - '*.gix':
        type: "file"
        description: "gix file"
        pattern: "*.{gix}"
        ontologies: []
  versions_fastga:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - fastga:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - "1.5.20260729":
        type: "string"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - fastga:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - "1.5.20260729":
        type: "string"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
authors:
- "@prototaxites"
maintainers:
- "@prototaxites"

    linux/amd64:
      name: "community.wave.seqera.io/library/fastga:1.5.20260729--8cb4c20b64de3563"
      build_id: "bd-8cb4c20b64de3563_1"
      scan_id: "sc-4b173310af5bba5c_1"
